title: Afternoon shift docket - GPU capacity & net reminders
content:
Purpose: quick personal docket for the afternoon shift — things to keep an eye on, commands I might run, and short handoff notes for night team. Informal, partial sentences, TODOs and watch items.

Context: cluster utilization creeping up after morning batch jobs. Observed some nodes with ephemeral network flaps (last week) and two P100s flagged with ECC after maintenance window — need to monitor. Dedicated customer lanes might need short burst capacity if trial goes live.

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Re-balance queued training jobs across pool-b. Goal: reduce average queued wait time from ~8m -> <3m. Quick plan: identify top 5 long-wait jobs and nudge to pool-c if compatible.
- [ ] Verify tenant-reserved capacity for account: redwood-analytics (check reserved-gpu counts). If under-allocated, prepare request for short burst (see PR #387).
- [ ] Patch rollback watch: new kernel rollforward still on canary nodes — confirm rollback is healthy (watch nodes node-az3-rack4).

Quick checks (commands to run)
- kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=gpu=true  # scan node Ready/taints
- ./scripts/gpu-pool-util.sh --pool pool-b --since 2h  # local utility (grep for >90% utilization)
- ssh ops@node-az3-rack4 sudo nvidia-smi -q | grep 'ECC Error' -A3  # check ECC count on flagged nodes
- docker logs -f infra-sidecar-queue --since 30m | grep -i backpressure  # look for queue saturation signatures

Observed anomalies:
- two pods on pool-b routinely OOM near step 120 of fine-tune scripts (potential config drift). Filesystem /tmp grows unexpectedly — possibly checkpoint write frequency. Action: add temp cleaning cron to image or add liveness probe to restart earlier.
- sporadic RTT spikes to registry.ecr from nodes in rack4 between 11:00–11:12 today (correlates with a burst of image pulls). Might be transient; keep an eye during next rollout.

Capacity numbers (rough):
- pool-a (inference): 48 A100s, target headroom 20%
- pool-b (training): 96 V100/P100 mix, current util 78%  <-- want <75% by EOD
- pool-c (overflow): 12 T4s (for fast cheap jobs)

Short tactics for reducing queue times
- encourage cheap short jobs to pool-c via placement hint (announce to eng Slack): "use --placement pool-c for dev/short jobs"
- enable burst allocation for redwood-analytics for 2 hours tonight -> request via ops-burst label +approve from Amira
- temporary throttle policy: lower max-concurrent-train-jobs per user from 6 to 4 (apply via quota-controller)

Networking reminders
- if registry.ecr latency repeats, open quick ticket with cloud-net and attach tcpdump from node (tcpdump -i eth0 host x.x.x.x and rotate 10MB)
- ensure BGP session on leaf-04 hasn't flapped in last 48h (check net-monitor)

Handoff notes for night crew
- Watch: node-az3-rack4 (suspect NIC queue overflow) — if packet drop >0.5% for 10m, migrate live low-priority jobs to pool-c and escalate to Evan.
- If queued-wait >10m for more than 30m, run requeue script: ./ops/requeue-long-waits.sh --threshold 10m  (script tags moved jobs to pool-c)
- If ECC errors increase on any GPU, file a hardware ticket (JIRA-INFRA-1423) and cordon node: kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data

Notes to self (ideas / follow-ups)
- small idea: expose per-tenant burst budget as an API so product teams can request automatic short bursts (would cut manual back-and-forth). Add to roadmap notes.
- experiment: run an autoscaler simulation on pool-b with synthetic short jobs to see if queue times drop under different bin-packing heuristics (next week).
- tidy up gpu-pool-util.sh to print per-tenant percent usage (makes quick chat messages easier).

Unresolved questions
- who owns the cron that nukes /tmp in training images? (looks like image-build team but file a quick ping)
- do we have true headroom numbers for dedicated customers beyond the current reserved counts? Need a small query to billing DB.

Quick links / refs
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/387  (burst provisioning changes)
- Jira: JIRA-INFRA-1423 (ECC failure triage)
- Slack: #infra-shift for immediate pings

End of docket — will update before handoff. If anything critical spikes, call +1 on Slack and mention @oncall-night.
